title: devices/{k}/ota/notify
description: The ota/notify payload. Campaign tasks carry campaignId and releaseId together; standalone tasks carry neither. packageCode and toVersion may be empty if the package was saved that way. A manifestVersion 2 task without its per-task signature is not notified; legacy tasks are. On ota/notify subscribe Rodak re-notifies only the latest active task. An authorized voice skill can also publish arbitrary payloads on device topics through the generic MQTT publishing path (current device topics except shadow/desired); this schema covers the OTA service only.
